alerts.title: Green River Ferry Temporarily Out of Service
alerts.description: The Green River Ferry has temporarily suspended operation due to low water levels. Ferry service will resume once water levels rise and conditions are safe. A river forecast is available at: water.noaa.gov/gauges/03309000

alerts.title: Elevator for Accessible Tour Out of Service
alerts.description: Due to mechanical issues with the cave elevator, the Accessible Tour is currently unavailable. Please check back for updates or call the visitor center at (270) 758-2180.

alerts.title: Temporary Closure of Select Trails for Rehabilitation Project
alerts.description: The Old Guides Trail, Heritage Trail, Sunset Point Trail and areas of the Sinkhole Trail are currently closed due to a trail rehabilitation project.

alerts.title: Tickets are required to enter Mammoth Cave
alerts.description: Reservations are strongly recommended. Reservations are the only way to ensure a spot is available for your party. Please plan accordingly by visiting Recreation.gov to secure your tickets in advance. Availability of walk-up tickets is not guaranteed.
